description.en: Original visualization in MoveIt's RapidPlan integration post: orange manipulator, green occupancy voxels, red obstacles, and coordinate axes create a layered spatial view of robot planning.

zh: 解释规划场景、机器人模型和占据空间如何共存于同一三维坐标系
需要展示避障或运动规划系统的中间几何表示与调试结果
论文技术视觉或项目主页需要传达空间结构，且确有对应几何数据支撑
en: Explaining a robot model, planning scene and occupancy space in one 3D frame
Visualizing geometric intermediates for motion planning and collision debugging
Presenting true spatial structure with evidence-backed geometry

zh: 深石墨背景让橙色机械臂成为明确的视觉锚点，绿色半透明体素提供空间尺度与占据证据
几何网格、机器人结构、红色物体和蓝色坐标轴按层组织，避免只有抽象箭头
保留透视空间与尺度关系，让读者看到障碍相对机械臂的位置而非只看算法名称
en: A dark graphite background foregrounds the orange robot; translucent green voxels explain occupied space
Robot geometry, objects and frame axes form separate visual layers instead of a purely symbolic flowchart
Use perspective, relative scale and occlusion to convey the relationship of obstacles to the manipulator

zh: 体素图是规划/场景表达示例，不自动证明碰撞检测正确、动态避障成功或真实机器人安全
如果没有真实的规划几何数据，不应为了好看而画虚构体素作为实验结果
颜色应有图例和物理解释；低对比度体素在论文缩小印刷时可能丢失，需要局部放大
en: A voxel screenshot is a scene illustration, not proof that the planner is correct, collision-free or safe on hardware
Never fabricate voxel occupancy and present it as a measured planning result
Provide a legend and check small-format readability; translucent voxels may disappear in print

insight.zh: 最值得学习的是通过配色、透视和真实几何叠加，把抽象碰撞空间变成直观空间证据；不是让画面具有赛博科技感就算好图。
insight.en: Its value is the use of color, perspective and true geometry to make abstract occupancy constraints visually intelligible, not decorative sci-fi styling.

zh: 橙色主机械臂作为前景主体，深灰色场景提供层次和留白
绿色细粒度体素栅格强调体积与可见空间约束，红色块状物成为障碍对照
RGB 坐标轴让端点/姿态有可参考的局部尺度，但没有证据的色块不应被解释成性能数字
en: Orange robot is the foreground anchor against a dark workcell background
Fine green occupancy voxels encode the spatial field while a red object provides a contrastive obstacle
Coordinate axes communicate local frame orientation but colors should not be mistaken for measured performance

zh: 从真实 URDF/机器人姿态、规划场景障碍与有来源的占据网格导出同一坐标系下的几何
分层设置机器人、不透明障碍、半透明体素、坐标轴的材质与透明度
配上精简图例说明规划可行性和实际执行状态各是哪一级证据
en: Export matched robot geometry, planning obstacles and source-grounded occupancy data in one coordinate frame
Layer an opaque robot, obstacles, translucent voxels and clearly drawn axes
Add a short legend distinguishing a computed candidate path from execution verification

zh: 已核实为 MoveIt 2019-04-16 RapidPlan Integration 公告实际配图，非 ROS-LLM 论文图
MoveIt 文中描述占据网格转换与规划后端性能；单张图自身不验证真实场景碰撞安全
en: Verified as a real image on MoveIt's April 16, 2019 RapidPlan integration announcement, not a ROS-LLM paper figure
The announcement discusses occupancy-grid conversion and planning speed; the image alone does not certify runtime collision safety
